title: GILEAD SCIENCES, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: Gilead Sciences filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of ArcCellx, Inc. on April 28, 2026. The acquisition was conducted via a tender offer followed by a short-form merger under Delaware law, with approximately 77.2% of ArcCellx shares tendered. The deal structure included $115.00 per share in cash plus a contingent value right (CVR) of up to $5.00 tied to anito-cel product sales exceeding $6.0 billion by December 31, 2029.
key_points: Gilead completed the acquisition of ArcCellx on April 28, 2026 via a reverse merger under DGCL Section 251(h)
Tender offer expired at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on April 27, 2026
38,795,604 shares were validly tendered, representing approximately 77.2% of outstanding shares
Base consideration: $115.00 per share in cash
Contingent Value Right: $5.00 per share payable on March 31, 2030 if cumulative anito-cel sales exceed $6.0 billion by December 31, 2029
ArcCellx is a Delaware corporation developing anito-cel, a CAR-T cell therapy
